camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListRules --region cn-hangzhou --RuleState Enabled --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a' --PageNumber 1 --ProjectId 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RuleName rule
description_en: Queries a list of authorization rules of a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下授权规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-rules --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --rule-name rule --rule-state Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRules

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the authorization rule to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的授权规则名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The state of the authorization rule to query.

Enabled

Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的授权规则状态。
Enabled：正常
Disabled：已禁用
parameters.name: rule_state
